brief: My complete AI-native startup stack: 6 tools that replaced an entire engineering team.

slots.tagline: Autocomplete, refactor, and ship entire features from natural language prompts.
slots.f1Body: Write and edit entire files through simple conversational instructions.
slots.f2Body: Understands your whole repo to suggest relevant cross-file changes.
slots.f3Body: Push to production without leaving the editor or losing flow state.

slots.tagline: Handles complex analysis, copy, architecture decisions, and customer communication autonomously.
slots.f1Body: Process hundred-page documents and maintain coherence across extended threads.
slots.f2Body: Breaks goals into steps and executes research or writing workflows end to end.
slots.f3Body: Produces reliable responses that follow your brand voice and technical constraints.

slots.tagline: Deploy frontend and serverless functions globally with zero configuration and instant previews.
slots.f1Body: Every push generates a live staging link for team review and feedback.
slots.f2Body: Serve dynamic content from the closest node for sub-second load times.
slots.f3Body: Run backend logic without managing servers, scaling, or infrastructure overhead.

slots.tagline: Postgres database, authentication, and realtime APIs in one open-source platform.
slots.f1Body: Add secure login with social providers and row-level security in minutes.
slots.f2Body: Subscribe to database changes and push live updates to connected clients instantly.
slots.f3Body: REST and GraphQL endpoints are built automatically from your table schema.

slots.tagline: Connect APIs, trigger actions, and run back-office tasks on a self-hosted canvas.
slots.f1Body: Drag and drop integrations without writing brittle custom scripts or cron jobs.
slots.f2Body: Keep sensitive data in your own infrastructure while scaling execution throughput.
slots.f3Body: Build fallback logic and alerts so broken steps never stall the business.

slots.tagline: Accept subscriptions, invoices, and global payments with developer-friendly APIs and webhooks.
slots.f1Body: Launch tiered plans, trials, and usage-based pricing without rebuilding your checkout.
slots.f2Body: Trigger post-payment workflows for provisioning, emails, and ledger updates instantly.
slots.f3Body: Automatically calculate and collect sales tax across international markets and jurisdictions.

slots.ctaBody: Replace overhead with intelligent tools. Start building your AI-native stack today and launch in days, not quarters.
